explanations.B: Amazon DynamoDB is a key-value database that provides high durability by replicating data across multiple Availability Zones. It is a standard architectural pattern for persistent, scalable session storage.
explanations.C: Amazon Cognito is used for user authentication, authorization, and user management (identities). It is not designed to store arbitrary transactional session state data for an application.
explanations.D: Amazon ElastiCache for Redis is an in-memory data store frequently used for session management due to its sub-millisecond latency. While primary in-memory, it supports replication and Multi-AZ failover, providing high availability for session data. (Note: While 'durability' is often associated with disk-based DBs, in the context of session management, Redis with Multi-AZ is a recognized AWS solution for session persistence).
explanations.E: AWS Systems Manager Application Manager is an operations tool for investigating and remediating issues with AWS resources. It is not a data storage service and cannot manage application-level user sessions.
explanations.correct: To ensure session data is not lost if an EC2 instance fails, the data must be stored externally to the web server. DynamoDB (B) and ElastiCache for Redis (D) are the managed services used to decouple session state from compute resources.

questions.text: A company needs a backup strategy for its three-tier stateless web application. The web application runs on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. The database tier runs on Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. The web application does not require temporary local storage on the EC2 instances. The company’s recovery point objective (RPO) is 2 hours. The backup strategy must maximize scalability and optimize resource utilization. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Take snapshots of Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes of the EC2 instances and database every 2 hours to meet the RPO.
options.B: Configure a snapshot lifecycle policy to take Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshots. Enable automated backups in Amazon RDS to meet the RPO.
options.C: Retain the latest Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) of the web and application tiers. Enable automated backups in Amazon RDS and use point-in-time recovery to meet the RPO.
options.D: Take snapshots of Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes of the EC2 instances every 2 hours. Enable automated backups in Amazon RDS and use point-in-time recovery to meet the RPO.

explanations.A: Taking EBS snapshots of individual EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group is inefficient for stateless applications. Since instances are ephemeral and scale dynamically, managing thousands of snapshots adds unnecessary overhead and cost.
explanations.B: This solution still focuses on EBS snapshots for the web tier. For a stateless application with no local data, backing up the volume of every scaled instance is a waste of resources.
explanations.C: Since the app is stateless and has no local storage requirements, an AMI (Amazon Machine Image) is all that is needed to launch identical new instances. For the database, RDS automated backups and Point-In-Time Recovery (PITR) easily meet an RPO of 2 hours (PITR typically allows recovery to within 5 minutes).
explanations.D: Like A and B, this unnecessarily backs up the EBS volumes of stateless instances every 2 hours, which does not optimize resource utilization compared to simply using a golden AMI.
explanations.correct: For stateless tiers, the 'backup' is the configuration and the AMI used to launch the instances. The only data that requires point-in-time protection is the RDS database. This combination provides the most efficient use of storage and management effort.

questions.text:
A company stores data in PDF format in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company must follow a legal requirement to retain all new and existing data in Amazon S3 for 7 years.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Turn on the S3 Versioning feature for the S3 bucket. Configure S3 Lifecycle to delete the data after 7 years. Configure multi-factor authentication (MFA) delete for all S3 objects.
options.B: Turn on S3 Object Lock with governance retention mode for the S3 bucket. Set the retention period to expire after 7 years. Recopy all existing objects to bring the existing data into compliance.
options.C: Turn on S3 Object Lock with compliance retention mode for the S3 bucket. Set the retention period to expire after 7 years. Recopy all existing objects to bring the existing data into compliance.
options.D: Turn on S3 Object Lock with compliance retention mode for the S3 bucket. Set the retention period to expire after 7 years. Use S3 Batch Operations to bring the existing data into compliance.

explanations.A: S3 Versioning and lifecycle rules do not provide write-once-read-many (WORM) protection and do not satisfy regulatory retention requirements.
explanations.B: Governance mode allows privileged users to override retention settings and therefore does not meet strict legal compliance requirements.
explanations.C: Manually recopying all objects introduces significant operational effort and risk compared to automated approaches.
explanations.D: S3 Object Lock in compliance mode enforces immutable retention, and S3 Batch Operations automate applying retention to existing objects at scale with minimal operational overhead.
explanations.correct: Compliance mode ensures regulatory retention, and S3 Batch Operations provide the most automated and scalable way to apply retention to existing objects.

questions.text:
A company runs its application on an Oracle database. The company plans to quickly migrate to AWS because of limited resources for the database, backup administration, and data center maintenance. The application uses third-party database features that require privileged access.

Which solution will help the company migrate the database to AWS MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Replace third-party features with cloud services.
options.B: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle. Customize the database settings to support third-party features.
options.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon EC2 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) for Oracle. Customize the database settings to support third-party features.
options.D: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL by rewriting the application code to remove dependency on Oracle APEX.

explanations.A: Standard RDS for Oracle does not allow the privileged OS and database access required for third-party features.
explanations.B: Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle provides managed automation while allowing privileged access, making it the most cost-effective option with low operational overhead.
explanations.C: Running Oracle on EC2 increases operational burden for backups, patching, and maintenance, making it less cost-effective.
explanations.D: Rewriting the application introduces significant development cost and migration effort.
explanations.correct: RDS Custom for Oracle balances managed service benefits with the required privileged access, minimizing cost and operational effort.

questions.text:
A company has a stateless web application that runs on AWS Lambda functions that are invoked by Amazon API Gateway. The company wants to deploy the application across multiple AWS Regions to provide Regional failover capabilities.

What should a solutions architect do to route traffic to multiple Regions?

options.A: Create Amazon Route 53 health checks for each Region. Use an active-active failover configuration.
options.B: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an origin for each Region. Use CloudFront health checks to route traffic.
options.C: Create a transit gateway. Attach the transit gateway to the API Gateway endpoint in each Region. Configure the transit gateway to route requests.
options.D: Create an Application Load Balancer in the primary Region. Set the target group to point to the API Gateway endpoint hostnames in each Region.

explanations.A: Route 53 health checks with active-active routing enable DNS-based regional failover for API Gateway endpoints.
explanations.B: CloudFront is primarily for content delivery and caching, not regional failover routing for APIs.
explanations.C: Transit Gateway is used for VPC connectivity and cannot route traffic to API Gateway endpoints.
explanations.D: Application Load Balancers do not support cross-Region load balancing.
explanations.correct: Route 53 provides native DNS failover and health checks for routing traffic across Regions.

questions.text:
A company has two VPCs named Management and Production. The Management VPC uses VPNs through a customer gateway to connect to a single device in the data center. The Production VPC uses a virtual private gateway with two attached AWS Direct Connect connections. The Management and Production VPCs both use a single VPC peering connection to allow communication between the applications.

What should a solutions architect do to mitigate any single point of failure in this architecture?

options.A: Add a set of VPNs between the Management and Production VPCs.
options.B: Add a second virtual private gateway and attach it to the Management VPC.
options.C: Add a second set of VPNs to the Management VPC from a second customer gateway device.
options.D: Add a second VPC peering connection between the Management VPC and the Production VPC.

explanations.A: VPC peering is already present and does not address the single customer gateway device.
explanations.B: A virtual private gateway alone does not remove the single on-premises device dependency.
explanations.C: Adding a second customer gateway and VPN provides redundancy and removes the single point of failure.
explanations.D: Multiple VPC peering connections do not improve resilience and are not supported for redundancy.
explanations.correct: Redundant VPNs with multiple customer gateways eliminate the single point of failure.

questions.text:
A company has a data ingestion workflow that consists of an Amazon SNS topic and an AWS Lambda function. The workflow fails occasionally because of network connectivity issues, causing data loss.

Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to ensure that the Lambda function ingests all data in the future? (Choose two.)

options.A: Deploy the Lambda function in multiple Availability Zones.
options.B: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue, and subscribe it to the SNS topic.
options.C: Increase the CPU and memory that are allocated to the Lambda function.
options.D: Increase provisioned throughput for the Lambda function.
options.E: Modify the Lambda function to read from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue.

explanations.A: Lambda is already multi-AZ by default and this does not prevent message loss.
explanations.B: SQS provides durable buffering so messages are retained during failures.
explanations.C: Increasing memory does not address message durability or retries.
explanations.D: Provisioned throughput is not applicable to Lambda event reliability.
explanations.E: Reading from SQS ensures messages are retried until successfully processed.
explanations.correct: Using SNS with SQS decouples ingestion and ensures durable, retryable message processing.

questions.text: A company wants to deploy a new public web application on AWS. The application includes a web server tier that uses Amazon EC2 instances and a database tier that uses an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. The application must be secure and accessible for global customers that have dynamic IP addresses. How should a solutions architect configure the security groups to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the security group for the web servers to allow inbound traffic on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Configure the security group for the DB instance to allow inbound traffic on port 3306 from the security group of the web servers.
options.B: Configure the security group for the web servers to allow inbound traffic on port 443 from the IP addresses of the customers. Configure the security group for the DB instance to allow inbound traffic on port 3306 from the security group of the web servers.
options.C: Configure the security group for the web servers to allow inbound traffic on port 443 from the IP addresses of the customers. Configure the security group for the DB instance to allow inbound traffic on port 3306 from the IP addresses of the customers.
options.D: Configure the security group for the web servers to allow inbound traffic on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Configure the security group for the DB instance to allow inbound traffic on port 3306 from 0.0.0.0/0.

explanations.A: This follows the principle of least privilege. Since customers have dynamic IPs, the web tier must be open to the world (0.0.0.0/0) on the application port (443). The database should only accept traffic from the web tier, achieved by referencing the web server's security group ID in the DB's inbound rules.
explanations.B: This is infeasible because customers have dynamic IP addresses; you cannot maintain a list of specific customer IPs in a security group rule.
explanations.C: This is insecure and infeasible. It requires exposing the database directly to dynamic customer IPs, which violates multi-tier security best practices.
explanations.D: This is insecure because it exposes the database tier (port 3306) to the entire internet (0.0.0.0/0), increasing the attack surface unnecessarily.
explanations.correct: Security groups should be chained. The web tier is public-facing, while the database tier should only be accessible from the web tier's security group.

questions.text: A payment processing company records all voice communication with its customers and stores the audio files in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs to capture the text from the audio files and remove any personally identifiable information (PII) belonging to customers. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Process the audio files by using Amazon Kinesis Video Streams. Use an AWS Lambda function to scan for known PII patterns.
options.B: When an audio file is uploaded to the S3 bucket, invoke an AWS Lambda function to start an Amazon Textract task to analyze the call recordings.
options.C: Configure an Amazon Transcribe transcription job with PII redaction turned on. When an audio file is uploaded to the S3 bucket, invoke an AWS Lambda function to start the transcription job. Store the output in a separate S3 bucket.
options.D: Create an Amazon Connect contact flow that ingests the audio files with transcription turned on. Embed an AWS Lambda function to scan for known PII patterns. Use Amazon EventBridge to start the contact flow when an audio file is uploaded to the S3 bucket.

explanations.A: Kinesis Video Streams is for streaming video and audio, not for batch processing S3 audio files for PII redaction. Manual scanning for PII patterns in Lambda is operationally heavy.
explanations.B: Amazon Textract is used to extract text from documents (PDFs, images), not to transcribe audio files.
explanations.C: Amazon Transcribe is the managed service for speech-to-text. It has a native 'PII Redaction' feature that automatically identifies and removes sensitive information, fulfilling the requirement with minimal operational overhead.
explanations.D: Amazon Connect is a contact center service. While it uses Transcribe, setting up a full contact flow for batch processing existing S3 files is overly complex and not the intended use case compared to a simple Transcribe job.
explanations.correct: Amazon Transcribe with PII redaction is the most efficient, managed solution for speech-to-text with sensitive data masking.

questions.text: A company runs a multi-tier ecommerce application on EC2 instances with an Amazon RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance. The database uses 2,000 GB of General Purpose SSD (gp3) storage. Performance degrades when read/write IOPS exceed 20,000. What should a solutions architect do to improve performance?

options.A: Replace the volume with a magnetic volume.
options.B: Increase the number of IOPS on the gp3 volume.
options.C: Replace the volume with a Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) volume.
options.D: Replace the 2,000 GB gp3 volume with two 1,000 GB gp3 volumes.

explanations.A: Magnetic volumes have the lowest performance and are not suitable for high-demand database workloads.
explanations.B: While gp3 allows provisioning up to 64,000 IOPS, the question implies a high-demand ecommerce application where 'io2 Block Express' (recently supported for RDS) provides superior durability and performance consistency for mission-critical databases compared to gp3.
explanations.C: As of early 2024, Amazon RDS supports io2 Block Express volumes, which are designed for sub-millisecond latency and high IOPS-to-GiB ratios. For an application consistently hitting 20,000+ IOPS, moving to Provisioned IOPS (io2) provides the most robust performance architecture.
explanations.D: Users cannot manually split an RDS instance into multiple EBS volumes in this manner; RDS manages the underlying striping automatically based on the storage type and size selected.
explanations.correct: Provisioned IOPS (io2) is the current best practice for mission-critical RDS workloads that exceed the typical performance profiles of General Purpose volumes.

questions.text: An IAM user made several configuration changes to AWS resources in their company's account during a production deployment last week. A solutions architect learned that a couple of security group rules are not configured as desired. The solutions architect wants to confirm which IAM user was responsible for making changes. Which service should the solutions architect use to find the desired information?

options.A: Amazon GuardDuty
options.B: Amazon Inspector
options.C: AWS CloudTrail
options.D: AWS Config

explanations.A: Amazon GuardDuty is a threat detection service that monitors for malicious activity and unauthorized behavior. It does not provide a historical audit log of API calls made by users.
explanations.B: Amazon Inspector is an automated vulnerability management service that scans EC2 instances, containers, and Lambda functions for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure.
explanations.C: AWS CloudTrail is the primary service for auditing, compliance, and governance. It records API calls made by or on behalf of an AWS account, including the identity of the caller (IAM user/role), the time of the call, and the parameters used (e.g., modifying security group rules).
explanations.D: AWS Config provides a detailed view of the configuration of AWS resources and how they relate to one another. While it tracks *how* a resource changed (the state), CloudTrail is needed to identify *who* initiated the change via an API call.

questions.text: A company has implemented a self-managed DNS service on AWS consisting of Amazon EC2 instances in different AWS Regions and endpoints of a standard accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. The company wants to protect the solution against DDoS attacks. What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.A: Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced. Add the accelerator as a resource to protect.
options.B: Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced. Add the EC2 instances as resources to protect.
options.C: Create an AWS WAF web ACL that includes a rate-based rule. Associate the web ACL with the accelerator.
options.D: Create an AWS WAF web ACL that includes a rate-based rule. Associate the web ACL with the EC2 instances.

explanations.A: AWS Shield Advanced provides expanded DDoS protection for several resource types, including AWS Global Accelerator. By adding the accelerator as a protected resource, Shield Advanced provides tailored mitigation against Layer 3 and Layer 4 attacks at the network edge, which is where the DDoS traffic first hits the Anycast IP addresses.
explanations.B: While Shield Advanced can protect EC2 instances, the Global Accelerator sits in front of the instances. To mitigate the attack at the entry point of the AWS global network and prevent the DNS service from being overwhelmed, the protection should be applied to the accelerator.
explanations.C: AWS WAF is a web application firewall that operates at Layer 7 (HTTP/HTTPS). DNS traffic usually operates over UDP/TCP port 53, which WAF cannot inspect or protect. Furthermore, WAF rate-based rules are not a complete DDoS mitigation strategy compared to Shield Advanced.
explanations.D: AWS WAF cannot be associated directly with EC2 instances (it is associated with ALBs, CloudFront, or API Gateway). Even if it could, it would not protect a DNS service against non-HTTP/S DDoS attacks.

questions.text: An ecommerce company needs to run a scheduled daily job to aggregate and filter sales records for analytics. The company stores the sales records in an Amazon S3 bucket. Each object can be up to 10 GB in size. Based on the number of sales events, the job can take up to an hour to complete. The CPU and memory usage of the job are constant and are known in advance. A solutions architect needs to minimize the amount of operational effort that is needed for the job to run. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function that has an Amazon EventBridge notification. Schedule the EventBridge event to run once a day.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function. Create an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API, and integrate the API with the function. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event that calls the API and invokes the function.
options.C: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with an AWS Fargate launch type. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event that launches an ECS task on the cluster to run the job.
options.D: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with an Amazon EC2 launch type and an Auto Scaling group with at least one EC2 instance. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event that launches an ECS task on the cluster to run the job.

explanations.A: Incorrect. AWS Lambda has a maximum execution timeout of 15 minutes. The requirement states the job takes up to an hour.
explanations.B: Incorrect. Similar to option A, Lambda cannot sustain a one-hour execution time. Additionally, adding API Gateway increases operational complexity unnecessarily.
explanations.C: Correct. AWS Fargate is a serverless compute engine for containers. It supports long-running tasks (up to the limits of the underlying hardware) and eliminates the need to manage EC2 instances, meeting the 'minimize operational effort' requirement.
explanations.D: Incorrect. While ECS on EC2 supports long-running tasks, it requires managing the underlying EC2 instances and Auto Scaling groups, which increases operational overhead compared to Fargate.

questions.text: A company needs to transfer 600 TB of data from its on-premises network-attached storage (NAS) system to the AWS Cloud. The data transfer must be complete within 2 weeks. The data is sensitive and must be encrypted in transit. The company’s internet connection can support an upload speed of 100 Mbps. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use Amazon S3 multi-part upload functionality to transfer the files over HTTPS.
options.B: Create a VPN connection between the on-premises NAS system and the nearest AWS Region. Transfer the data over the VPN connection.
options.C: Use the AWS Snow Family console to order several AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices. Use the devices to transfer the data to Amazon S3.
options.D: Set up a 10 Gbps AWS Direct Connect connection between the company location and the nearest AWS Region. Transfer the data over a VPN connection into the Region to store the data in Amazon S3.

explanations.A: Incorrect. At 100 Mbps, transferring 600 TB would take approximately 555 days, exceeding the 2-week requirement.
explanations.B: Incorrect. A VPN over a 100 Mbps connection faces the same bandwidth bottleneck as option A.
explanations.C: Correct. AWS Snowball Edge is designed for large-scale data transfers where bandwidth is limited. Multiple devices can be used in parallel to move 600 TB within the 2-week window.
explanations.D: Incorrect. While a 10 Gbps Direct Connect could technically handle the transfer in about 6 days, the lead time for provisioning a new Direct Connect connection typically exceeds the 2-week requirement.

questions.text: A company has thousands of edge devices that collectively generate 1 TB of status alerts each day. Each alert is approximately 2 KB in size. A solutions architect needs to implement a solution to ingest and store the alerts for future analysis. The company wants a highly available solution and needs to minimize costs and does not want to manage additional infrastructure. The company wants to keep 14 days of data available for immediate analysis and archive any data older than 14 days. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution?

options.A: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to ingest the alerts. Configure the Kinesis Data Firehose stream to deliver the alerts to an Amazon S3 bucket. Set up an S3 Lifecycle configuration to transition data to Amazon S3 Glacier after 14 days.
options.B: Launch Amazon EC2 instances across two Availability Zones and place them behind an Elastic Load Balancer to ingest the alerts. Create a script on the EC2 instances that will store the alerts in an Amazon S3 bucket. Set up an S3 Lifecycle configuration to transition data to Amazon S3 Glacier after 14 days.
options.C: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to ingest the alerts. Configure the Kinesis Data Firehose stream to deliver the alerts to an Amazon OpenSearch Service cluster. Set up the cluster to take manual snapshots every day and delete data older than 14 days.
options.D: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue to ingest the alerts, and set the message retention period to 14 days. Configure consumers to poll the SQS queue and archive data to S3.

explanations.A: Correct. Kinesis Data Firehose is a fully managed (serverless) ingestion service that automatically scales. Delivering to S3 with a Lifecycle policy to Glacier meets the availability and archival requirements with the least operational overhead.
explanations.B: Incorrect. This requires managing EC2 instances, which contradicts the goal of minimizing managed infrastructure.
explanations.C: Incorrect. OpenSearch Service clusters require management of instances/nodes and storage. It is significantly more operationally complex and expensive than the S3/Firehose solution for simple storage.
explanations.D: Incorrect. SQS is a messaging queue, not a long-term storage or ingestion-to-archive service. Using consumers to manage archival adds significant operational overhead compared to Firehose's native S3 integration.

questions.text: A financial company hosts a web application on AWS. The application uses an Amazon API Gateway Regional API endpoint to give users the ability to retrieve current stock prices. The security team is concerned that HTTP flood attacks might take the application offline. Which solution protects the application from this type of attack with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the API Gateway Regional API endpoint with a maximum TTL of 24 hours.
options.B: Create a Regional AWS WAF web ACL with a rate-based rule. Associate the web ACL with the API Gateway stage.
options.C: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to monitor the Count metric and alert the security team when the predefined rate is reached.
options.D: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with Lambda@Edge in front of the API Gateway Regional API endpoint. Create an AWS Lambda function to block requests from IP addresses that exceed the predefined rate.

explanations.A: Incorrect. While CloudFront can help mitigate some traffic, a 24-hour TTL is inappropriate for dynamic stock price data and does not natively block flood attacks based on IP rate.
explanations.B: Correct. AWS WAF rate-based rules are specifically designed to mitigate HTTP flood attacks by automatically blocking IP addresses that exceed a defined threshold. Associating it with the API Gateway stage is a managed, low-overhead solution.
explanations.C: Incorrect. Monitoring and alerting provide visibility but do not offer automated protection or mitigation during an attack.
explanations.D: Incorrect. While technically possible, this is a 'custom' solution that involves writing and maintaining code, which increases operational overhead compared to using the native WAF rate-based rule.

questions.text: An application runs on an Amazon EC2 instance in a VPC. The application processes logs that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The EC2 instance needs to access the S3 bucket without connectivity to the internet. Which solution will provide private network connectivity to Amazon S3?

options.A: Create a gateway VPC endpoint to the S3 bucket.
options.B: Stream the logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Export the logs to the S3 bucket.
options.C: Create an instance profile on Amazon EC2 to allow S3 access.
options.D: Create an Amazon API Gateway API with a private link to access the S3 endpoint.

explanations.A: Correct. Gateway VPC endpoints provide private connectivity to S3 (and DynamoDB) from within a VPC without requiring an Internet Gateway or NAT Gateway.
explanations.B: Incorrect. This does not address the underlying connectivity requirement for the EC2 instance to interact with S3 or CloudWatch privately without extra configuration (like Interface Endpoints for CloudWatch).
explanations.C: Incorrect. An instance profile provides IAM authorization, but it does not provide network routing or connectivity.
explanations.D: Incorrect. API Gateway is not the standard or efficient way to provide private connectivity to S3; VPC Endpoints are the native AWS solution for this.

questions.text:
A company has a three-tier web application that is in a single server. The company wants to migrate the application to the AWS Cloud. The company also wants the application to align with the AWS Well-Architected Framework and to be consistent with AWS recommended best practices for security, scalability, and resiliency.

Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a VPC across two Availability Zones with the application's existing architecture. Host the application with existing architecture on an Amazon EC2 instance in a private subnet in each Availability Zone with EC2 Auto Scaling groups. Secure the EC2 instance with security groups and network ACLs.
options.B: Set up security groups and network access control lists (network ACLs) to control access to the database layer. Set up a single Amazon RDS database in a private subnet.
options.C: Create a VPC across two Availability Zones. Refactor the application to host the web tier, application tier, and database tier. Host each tier on its own subnet with Auto Scaling groups for the web tier and application tier.
options.D: Use a single Amazon RDS database. Allow database access only from the application tier security group.
options.E: Use Elastic Load Balancers in front of the web tier. Control access by using security groups containing references to each layer's security groups.
options.F: Use an Amazon RDS database Multi-AZ deployment in private subnets. Allow database access only from application tier security groups.

explanations.A: Reusing the existing single-server architecture limits resiliency and does not properly separate tiers according to AWS best practices.
explanations.B: A single Amazon RDS database does not provide high availability and does not align with resiliency best practices.
explanations.C: Separating web, application, and database tiers across multiple Availability Zones improves scalability, security, and fault tolerance.
explanations.D: A single RDS database instance lacks built-in failover and does not meet resiliency requirements.
explanations.E: Elastic Load Balancers improve availability and scalability by distributing traffic across multiple instances.
explanations.F: Amazon RDS Multi-AZ deployments provide automatic failover and high availability, aligning with the Resilience pillar.
explanations.correct: Options C, E, and F together provide a multi-tier, highly available, scalable, and resilient architecture aligned with AWS Well-Architected best practices.

questions.text:
A company is migrating its applications and databases to the AWS Cloud. The company will use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS), AWS Direct Connect, and Amazon RDS.

Which activities will be managed by the company's operational team?

options.A: Management of the Amazon RDS infrastructure layer, operating system, and platforms
options.B: Creation of an Amazon RDS DB instance and configuring the scheduled maintenance window
options.C: Configuration of additional software components on Amazon ECS for monitoring, patch management, log management, and host intrusion detection
options.D: Installation of patches for all minor and major database versions for Amazon RDS
options.E: Ensure the physical security of the Amazon RDS infrastructure in the data center
options.F: Encryption of the data that moves in transit through Direct Connect

explanations.A: AWS manages the underlying infrastructure, operating system, and platform for Amazon RDS.
explanations.B: Customers are responsible for creating RDS instances and configuring maintenance windows.
explanations.C: Customers must configure monitoring, logging, and security tooling for workloads running on ECS.
explanations.D: AWS manages patching of the database engine for Amazon RDS.
explanations.E: AWS is responsible for physical security of its data centers.
explanations.F: Direct Connect does not provide encryption by default; customers must implement encryption in transit.
explanations.correct: Options B, C, and F correctly reflect customer responsibilities under the AWS Shared Responsibility Model.

questions.text:
A company wants to implement a backup strategy for Amazon EC2 data and multiple Amazon S3 buckets. Because of regulatory requirements, the company must retain backup files for a specific time period. The company must not alter the files for the duration of the retention period.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Backup to create a backup vault that has a vault lock in governance mode. Create the required backup plan.
options.B: Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager to create the required automated snapshot policy.
options.C: Use Amazon S3 File Gateway to create the backup. Configure the appropriate S3 Lifecycle management.
options.D: Use AWS Backup to create a backup vault that has a vault lock in compliance mode. Create the required backup plan.

explanations.A: Governance mode allows privileged users to delete or modify backups, which does not meet strict immutability requirements.
explanations.B: Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager does not provide immutable backups with enforced retention.
explanations.C: S3 Lifecycle policies do not prevent deletion or modification during a mandatory retention period.
explanations.D: Compliance mode enforces immutable backups that cannot be altered or deleted until the retention period expires.
explanations.correct: Compliance mode vault lock ensures backups are immutable for regulatory compliance.

questions.text:
A company runs a Java-based job on an Amazon EC2 instance. The job runs every hour and takes 10 seconds to run. The job consumes 1 GB of memory, and CPU utilization is low except for short surges. The company wants to optimize the costs to run the job.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS App2Container to containerize the job and run it as an Amazon ECS task on AWS Fargate.
options.B: Copy the code into an AWS Lambda function with 1 GB of memory and use Amazon EventBridge to run it every hour.
options.C: Use AWS App2Container and install the container in the existing Amazon Machine Image.
options.D: Stop and restart the EC2 instance for each scheduled job execution.

explanations.A: Fargate reduces infrastructure management but is still more expensive than short-lived serverless execution.
explanations.B: AWS Lambda charges only for execution time and memory used, making it the most cost-effective option.
explanations.C: Maintaining EC2-based containers does not significantly reduce operational or cost overhead.
explanations.D: Stopping and starting EC2 instances still incurs management overhead and is less cost-efficient.
explanations.correct: AWS Lambda with EventBridge provides the lowest cost and minimal operational overhead for short, infrequent jobs.

questions.text:
A company has resources across multiple AWS Regions and accounts. A solutions architect needs to build and map the relationship details of the various workloads across all accounts.

Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.B: Use AWS Step Functions and manually build architecture diagrams.

explanations.C: Workload Discovery on AWS automatically discovers resources and visualizes relationships across accounts and Regions.
explanations.D: AWS X-Ray focuses on application tracing, not infrastructure relationship mapping.
explanations.correct: Workload Discovery on AWS is purpose-built for automated workload visualization and relationship mapping.

questions.text: A company needs to ingest and handle large amounts of streaming data that its application generates. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances and sends data to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams, which is configured with default settings. Every other day, the application consumes the data and writes the data to an Amazon S3 bucket for business intelligence (BI) processing. The company observes that Amazon S3 is not receiving all the data that the application sends to Kinesis Data Streams. What should a solutions architect do to resolve this issue?

options.A: Update the Kinesis Data Streams default settings by modifying the data retention period.
options.B: Update the application to use the Kinesis Producer Library (KPL) to send the data to Kinesis Data Streams.
options.C: Update the number of Kinesis shards to handle the throughput of the data that is sent to Kinesis Data Streams.
options.D: Turn on S3 Versioning within the S3 bucket to preserve every version of every object that is ingested in the S3 bucket.

explanations.A: Kinesis Data Streams has a default retention period of 24 hours. Since the application only consumes data 'every other day' (every 48 hours), data older than 24 hours is being deleted before it can be processed. Increasing the retention period (up to 365 days) resolves this.
explanations.B: While KPL improves producer efficiency, it does not solve the issue of data disappearing from the stream due to retention limits.
explanations.C: Increasing shards helps with ingestion throughput (shunning 'ProvisionedThroughputExceededException'), but the scenario implies a loss over time ('every other day'), pointing to retention.
explanations.D: S3 Versioning protects against overwrites/deletions in S3, but the data is failing to reach S3 in the first place.
explanations.correct: The 'every other day' requirement directly conflicts with the 24-hour default retention period of Kinesis Data Streams.

questions.text: A developer has an application that uses an AWS Lambda function to upload files to Amazon S3 and needs the required permissions to perform the task. The developer already has an IAM user with valid IAM credentials required for Amazon S3. What should a solutions architect do to grant the permissions?

options.A: Add required IAM permissions in the resource policy of the Lambda function.
options.B: Create a signed request using the existing IAM credentials in the Lambda function.
options.C: Create a new IAM user and use the existing IAM credentials in the Lambda function.
options.D: Create an IAM execution role with the required permissions and attach the IAM role to the Lambda function.

explanations.A: Resource policies for Lambda (Function Policy) control which services or accounts can *invoke* the function, not what the function can *access*.
explanations.B: Hardcoding or passing IAM user credentials into Lambda code is a security anti-pattern.
explanations.C: Creating additional IAM users and managing long-term credentials increases operational overhead and security risk.
explanations.D: An IAM execution role is the standard AWS best practice for granting a Lambda function permissions to access other AWS services securely without managing long-term credentials.
explanations.correct: Lambda functions use Execution Roles (Identity-based policies) to obtain temporary security credentials to call AWS APIs.

questions.text: A company wants to use the AWS Cloud to make an existing application highly available and resilient. The current version of the application resides in the company's data center. The application recently experienced data loss after a database server crashed because of an unexpected power outage. The company needs a solution that avoids any single points of failure. The solution must give the application the ability to scale to meet user demand. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy the application servers by using Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. Use an Amazon RDS DB instance in a Multi-AZ configuration.
options.B: Deploy the application servers by using Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group in a single Availability Zone. Deploy the database on an EC2 instance. Enable EC2 Auto Recovery.
options.C: Deploy the application servers by using Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. Use an Amazon RDS DB instance with a read replica in a single Availability Zone. Promote the read replica to replace the primary DB instance if the primary DB instance fails.
options.D: Deploy the application servers by using Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. Deploy the primary and secondary database servers on EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones. Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach to create shared storage between the instances.

explanations.A: This leverages Multi-AZ for both compute (Auto Scaling) and database (RDS Multi-AZ), eliminating single points of failure and providing scalability.
explanations.B: Using a single Availability Zone and a single-instance database on EC2 does not provide high availability or resilience.
explanations.C: RDS Read Replicas are for scaling reads, not for high availability. While they can be promoted, Multi-AZ is the managed solution for automated failover and zero data loss.
explanations.D: EBS Multi-Attach has strict limitations (Nitro-based, clustered file systems like GFS2) and does not natively support Multi-AZ failover for databases as effectively as RDS.
explanations.correct: Multi-AZ deployments for RDS and Auto Scaling groups across AZs are the fundamental building blocks for resilient AWS architectures.

questions.text: A company has deployed a serverless application that invokes an AWS Lambda function when new documents are uploaded to an Amazon S3 bucket. After a recent marketing campaign, the company noticed that the application did not process many of the documents. What should a solutions architect do to improve the architecture of this application?

options.A: Set the Lambda function's runtime timeout value to 15 minutes.
options.B: Configure an S3 bucket replication policy. Stage the documents in the S3 bucket for later processing.
options.C: Deploy an additional Lambda function. Load balance the processing of the documents across the two Lambda functions.
options.D: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Send the requests to the queue. Configure the queue as an event source for Lambda.

explanations.A: Timeout increase doesn't help if the issue is function throttling or concurrency limits during a traffic spike.
explanations.B: S3 replication is for disaster recovery/latency, not for triggering asynchronous processing logic.
explanations.C: Lambda scales automatically; you don't 'load balance' between two identical functions manually.
explanations.D: Adding an SQS queue acts as a buffer. This prevents data loss during bursts of traffic (like a marketing campaign) by decoupling the ingestion (S3) from the processing (Lambda).
explanations.correct: Decoupling with SQS allows the system to handle spikes in traffic by queuing requests and processing them at a controlled rate (throttling) or scaling the consumer.

questions.text: A meteorological startup company has a custom web application to sell weather data. The company uses Amazon DynamoDB to store its data and wants to build a new service that sends an alert to the managers of four internal teams every time a new weather event is recorded. The company does not want this new service to affect the performance of the current application. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?

options.A: Use DynamoDB transactions to write new event data to the table. Configure the transactions to notify internal teams.
options.B: Have the current application publish a message to four Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topics. Have each team subscribe to one topic.
options.C: Enable Amazon DynamoDB Streams on the table. Use triggers to write to a single Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to which the teams can subscribe.
options.D: Add a custom attribute to each record to flag new items. Write a cron job that scans the table every minute for items that are new and notifies an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to which the teams can subscribe.

explanations.A: DynamoDB transactions are for atomicity across multiple items, not for notifications. It would add complexity and performance overhead.
explanations.B: This requires modifying the application code, which increases operational overhead and couples the notification logic with the primary application logic.
explanations.C: DynamoDB Streams capture changes asynchronously without affecting the performance of the main table. Using a Lambda trigger to push to SNS is the most managed, low-overhead way to fan out notifications.
explanations.D: Scanning a table via cron is highly inefficient, costly as the table grows, and not real-time.
explanations.correct: DynamoDB Streams provide a seamless way to respond to data changes in real-time with zero impact on the database's request performance.

A company uses AWS Organizations. The company wants to operate some of its AWS accounts with different budgets. The company wants to receive alerts and automatically prevent provisioning of additional resources on AWS accounts when the allocated budget threshold is met during a specific period.

Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Budgets to create a budget. Set the budget amount under the Cost and Usage Reports section of the required AWS accounts.
options.B: Use AWS Budgets to create a budget. Set the budget amount under the Billing dashboards of the required AWS accounts.
options.C: Create an IAM user for AWS Budgets to run budget actions with the required permissions.
options.D: Create an IAM role for AWS Budgets to run budget actions with the required permissions.
options.E: Add an alert to notify the company when each account meets its budget threshold. Add a budget action that selects the IAM identity created with the appropriate config rule to prevent provisioning of additional resources.
options.F: Add an alert to notify the company when each account meets its budget threshold. Add a budget action that selects the IAM identity created with the appropriate service control policy (SCP) to prevent provisioning of additional resources.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Cost and Usage Reports are for reporting and analytics, not for defining budget thresholds.
explanations.B: Correct. AWS Budgets are created and managed from the Billing and Cost Management console.
explanations.C: Incorrect. AWS Budgets actions require an IAM role, not an IAM user.
explanations.D: Correct. An IAM role is required for AWS Budgets to perform automated actions.
explanations.E: Incorrect. AWS Config rules cannot directly prevent resource provisioning at the account level.
explanations.F: Correct. SCPs are the correct mechanism to centrally prevent resource provisioning across accounts.
explanations.correct: AWS Budgets with alerts, IAM roles, and SCP-based budget actions provide automated spend control with minimal operational overhead.

questions.text:
A company runs applications on Amazon EC2 instances in one AWS Region. The company wants to back up the EC2 instances to a second Region. The company also wants to provision EC2 resources in the second Region and manage the EC2 instances centrally from one AWS account.

Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a disaster recovery (DR) plan that has a similar number of EC2 instances in the second Region. Configure data replication.
options.B: Create point-in-time Amazon EBS snapshots of the EC2 instances. Copy the snapshots to the second Region periodically.
options.C: Create a backup plan by using AWS Backup. Configure cross-Region backup to the second Region for the EC2 instances.
options.D: Deploy a similar number of EC2 instances in the second Region. Use AWS DataSync to transfer the data from the source Region to the second Region.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Running standby EC2 instances increases cost significantly.
explanations.B: Incorrect. Manual snapshot management increases operational overhead.
explanations.C: Correct. AWS Backup provides centralized, automated, and cost-effective cross-Region EC2 backups.
explanations.D: Incorrect. AWS DataSync is not optimized for recurring EC2 backups and increases cost.
explanations.correct: AWS Backup minimizes cost and operational effort while supporting centralized management and cross-Region recovery.

questions.text:
A company uses AWS Organizations to run workloads within multiple AWS accounts. A tagging policy adds department tags to AWS resources when the company creates tags.

An accounting team needs to determine spending on Amazon EC2 consumption by department across all accounts.

Which solution meets these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: From the Organizations management account billing console, activate a user-defined cost allocation tag named department. Create one cost report in Cost Explorer grouping by tag name, and filter by EC2.
options.B: From the Organizations management account billing console, activate an AWS-defined cost allocation tag named department. Create one cost report in Cost Explorer grouping by tag name, and filter by EC2.
options.C: From the Organizations member account billing console, activate a user-defined cost allocation tag named department. Create one cost report in Cost Explorer grouping by the tag name, and filter by EC2.
options.D: From the Organizations member account billing console, activate an AWS-defined cost allocation tag named department. Create one cost report in Cost Explorer grouping by tag name, and filter by EC2.

explanations.A: Correct. Activating user-defined tags in the management account enables organization-wide cost reporting.
explanations.B: Incorrect. AWS-defined tags cannot be custom department tags.
explanations.C: Incorrect. Tag activation must be done in the management account.
explanations.D: Incorrect. AWS-defined tags do not apply to custom department tagging.
explanations.correct: Management-account activation of user-defined cost allocation tags ensures centralized and efficient cost tracking.

questions.text:
A company is building an application to transfer data to a product manufacturer. The company has its own identity provider (IdP) and must use the Applicability Statement 2 (AS2) protocol.

Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS DataSync to transfer the data. Create an AWS Lambda function for IdP authentication.
options.B: Use Amazon AppFlow flows to transfer the data. Create an Amazon ECS task for IdP authentication.
options.C: Use AWS Transfer Family to transfer the data. Create an AWS Lambda function for IdP authentication.
options.D: Use AWS Storage Gateway to transfer the data. Create an Amazon Cognito identity pool for IdP authentication.

explanations.A: Incorrect. AWS DataSync does not support the AS2 protocol.
explanations.B: Incorrect. Amazon AppFlow does not support AS2-based B2B transfers.
explanations.C: Correct. AWS Transfer Family natively supports AS2 and integrates with custom IdPs using AWS Lambda.
explanations.D: Incorrect. AWS Storage Gateway does not support AS2.
explanations.correct: AWS Transfer Family with Lambda-based custom authentication provides secure, managed AS2 transfers.

questions.text:
A solutions architect is designing a REST API in Amazon API Gateway for a cash payback service. The application requires 1 GB of memory and 2 GB of storage for its computation resources. The data must be stored in a relational format.

Which combination of AWS services will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative effort?

options.A: Amazon EC2
options.B: AWS Lambda
options.C: Amazon RDS
options.D: Amazon DynamoDB
options.E: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)

explanations.A: Incorrect. EC2 requires server management and higher operational effort.
explanations.B: Correct. AWS Lambda supports required memory and storage with minimal administration.
explanations.C: Correct. Amazon RDS provides managed relational databases.
explanations.D: Incorrect. DynamoDB is a NoSQL database.
explanations.E: Incorrect. EKS introduces unnecessary operational complexity.
explanations.correct: AWS Lambda with Amazon RDS delivers a fully managed, scalable, and low-overhead architecture.

questions.text: A solutions architect is designing the architecture for a software demonstration environment. The environment will run on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The system will experience significant increases in traffic during working hours but is not required to operate on weekends. Which combination of actions should the solutions architect take to ensure that the system can scale to meet demand? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Auto Scaling to adjust the ALB capacity based on request rate.
options.B: Use AWS Auto Scaling to scale the capacity of the VPC internet gateway.
options.C: Launch the EC2 instances in multiple AWS Regions to distribute the load across Regions.
options.D: Use a target tracking scaling policy to scale the Auto Scaling group based on instance CPU utilization.
options.E: Use scheduled scaling to change the Auto Scaling group minimum, maximum, and desired capacity to zero for weekends. Revert to the default values at the start of the week.

explanations.A: AWS Auto Scaling manages the number of EC2 instances in a target group; it does not directly scale the internal capacity of the ALB itself, which scales automatically based on traffic patterns.
explanations.B: The VPC Internet Gateway is a horizontally scaled, redundant, and highly available VPC component that does not require manual scaling or Auto Scaling.
explanations.C: Multi-region deployment is for disaster recovery or global latency reduction, not for local scaling of a demonstration environment.
explanations.D: Target tracking scaling policies allow the Auto Scaling group to dynamically add or remove instances to maintain a specific metric (like CPU), handling the increased traffic during working hours.
explanations.E: Scheduled scaling is the most efficient way to handle known periods of zero utilization (weekends), allowing the environment to shut down and restart automatically.
explanations.correct: D provides dynamic scaling for variable demand during the day, while E addresses the specific requirement for weekend inactivity.

questions.text: A company runs an application that receives data from thousands of geographically dispersed remote devices that use UDP. The application processes the data immediately and sends a message back to the device if necessary. No data is stored. The company needs a solution that minimizes latency for the data transmission from the devices. The solution also must provide rapid failover to another AWS Region. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure an Amazon Route 53 failover routing policy. Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in each of the two Regions. Configure the NLB to invoke an AWS Lambda function to process the data.
options.B: Use AWS Global Accelerator. Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in each of the two Regions as an endpoint. Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with the Fargate launch type. Create an ECS service on the cluster. Set the ECS service as the target for the NLB. Process the data in Amazon ECS.
options.C: Use AWS Global Accelerator. Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in each of the two Regions as an endpoint. Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with the Fargate launch type. Create an ECS service on the cluster. Set the ECS service as the target for the ALB. Process the data in Amazon ECS.
options.D: Configure an Amazon Route 53 failover routing policy. Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in each of the two Regions. Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with the Fargate launch type. Create an ECS service on the cluster. Set the ECS service as the target for the ALB. Process the data in Amazon ECS.

explanations.A: Route 53 relies on DNS TTL for failover, which is slower than Global Accelerator's Anycast IP failover and does not optimize the network path as effectively as Global Accelerator.
explanations.B: Global Accelerator provides Anycast IPs to ingest traffic at the edge, reducing latency. It supports UDP and provides fast failover. NLB is required because the protocol is UDP.
explanations.C: Application Load Balancers (ALB) operate at Layer 7 and do not support the UDP protocol; they only support HTTP/HTTPS and gRPC.
explanations.D: Like option C, this uses ALB which doesn't support UDP, and Route 53 is slower for failover compared to Global Accelerator.
explanations.correct: AWS Global Accelerator with NLB is the standard architecture for low-latency UDP ingestion with multi-region failover.

questions.text: A solutions architect is designing a two-tiered architecture that includes a public subnet and a database subnet. The web servers in the public subnet must be open to the internet on port 443. The Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance in the database subnet must be accessible only to the web servers on port 3306. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create a network ACL for the public subnet. Add a rule to deny outbound traffic to 0.0.0.0/0 on port 3306.
options.B: Create a security group for the DB instance. Add a rule to allow traffic from the public subnet CIDR block on port 3306.
options.C: Create a security group for the web servers in the public subnet. Add a rule to allow traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443.
options.D: Create a security group for the DB instance. Add a rule to allow traffic from the web servers’ security group on port 3306.
options.E: Create a security group for the DB instance. Add a rule to deny all traffic except traffic from the web servers’ security group on port 3306.

explanations.A: NACLs are stateless and usually applied at the subnet level. While possible, security groups are the preferred method for fine-grained instance-level access control.
explanations.B: Allowing the entire public subnet CIDR is less secure than referencing the specific security group of the web servers.
explanations.C: This is necessary to allow HTTPS traffic from the internet to the web tier.
explanations.D: Security group referencing is a best practice. It allows traffic from any instance associated with the web security group without needing to track individual IP addresses.
explanations.E: Security Groups are 'allow-only' by design. You cannot create explicit 'deny' rules in a security group.
explanations.correct: C opens the web tier to the internet, and D provides secure, least-privilege access to the database by referencing the web tier's security group.

questions.text: A company is implementing a shared storage solution for a gaming application that is hosted in the AWS Cloud. The company needs the ability to use Lustre clients to access data. The solution must be fully managed. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Create an AWS DataSync task that shares the data as a mountable file system. Mount the file system to the application server.
options.B: Create an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway. Create a file share that uses the required client protocol. Connect the application server to the file share.
options.C: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system, and configure it to support Lustre. Attach the file system to the origin server. Connect the application server to the file system.
options.D: Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Attach the file system to the origin server. Connect the application server to the file system.

explanations.A: DataSync is a data transfer service, not a shared file storage solution.
explanations.B: Storage Gateway provides SMB or NFS interfaces, not the Lustre protocol required for high-performance parallel access.
explanations.C: Amazon EFS is a managed NFS file system and does not support the Lustre protocol.
explanations.D: Amazon FSx for Lustre is a fully managed service that natively supports Lustre clients and is designed for high-performance computing and gaming workloads.
explanations.correct: FSx for Lustre is the only AWS managed service that supports the Lustre protocol.

questions.text: A solutions architect must migrate a Windows Internet Information Services (IIS) web application to AWS. The application currently relies on a file share hosted in the user's on-premises network-attached storage (NAS). The solutions architect has proposed migrating the IIS web servers to Amazon EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones that are connected to the storage solution, and configuring an Elastic Load Balancer attached to the instances. Which replacement to the on-premises file share is MOST resilient and durable?

options.A: Migrate the file share to Amazon RDS.
options.B: Migrate the file share to AWS Storage Gateway.
options.C: Migrate the file share to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server.
options.D: Migrate the file share to Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS).

explanations.A: Amazon RDS is a relational database service, not a file storage service for SMB shares.
explanations.B: Storage Gateway is primarily for hybrid scenarios; while it can provide file shares, FSx for Windows is a more native, high-performance solution for Windows workloads.
explanations.C: FSx for Windows File Server provides fully managed, highly reliable SMB file shares that natively support Windows features like AD integration and NTFS permissions.
explanations.D: Amazon EFS is primarily for Linux workloads (NFS). While Windows can mount NFS, FSx for Windows is the superior and more resilient choice for IIS/Windows environments.
explanations.correct: FSx for Windows File Server is the native AWS managed service for Windows SMB shares.

questions.text: A company has an application that provides marketing services to stores. Stores upload transaction data through SFTP to Amazon S3, and some files can exceed 200 GB. The company discovered that some files contain personally identifiable information (PII). Administrators must be alerted if PII is shared again, and remediation should be automated with the least development effort. What should a solutions architect do?

options.A: Use Amazon S3 as a secure transfer point and Amazon Inspector to scan objects. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to remove objects that contain PII.
options.B: Use Amazon S3 as a secure transfer point and Amazon Macie to scan objects. Use Amazon SNS to notify administrators if PII is detected.
options.C: Implement custom PII scanning algorithms in AWS Lambda triggered on object upload and use Amazon SNS for notifications.
options.D: Implement custom PII scanning algorithms in AWS Lambda triggered on object upload and use Amazon SES for notifications and S3 Lifecycle policies for deletion.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Amazon Inspector is designed for vulnerability management, not for detecting PII in S3 objects.
explanations.B: Correct. Amazon Macie is a fully managed service purpose-built for discovering PII in Amazon S3 and can publish findings that trigger notifications with minimal development effort.
explanations.C: Incorrect. Custom PII detection logic in Lambda requires significant development and maintenance effort compared to using Macie.
explanations.D: Incorrect. This option requires custom development and incorrectly implies that S3 Lifecycle policies can be triggered dynamically for specific objects.
explanations.correct: Using Amazon Macie with SNS provides automated PII discovery and administrator alerting with the least development and operational overhead.

questions.text: A company wants to securely exchange data between its Salesforce SaaS application and Amazon S3. Data must be encrypted at rest using AWS KMS customer managed keys and encrypted in transit. API access is enabled for Salesforce. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Create AWS Lambda functions to transfer the data securely from Salesforce to Amazon S3.
options.B: Create an AWS Step Functions workflow to transfer the data securely from Salesforce to Amazon S3.
options.C: Create Amazon AppFlow flows to transfer the data securely from Salesforce to Amazon S3.
options.D: Create a custom connector for Salesforce to transfer the data securely from Salesforce to Amazon S3.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Custom Lambda-based integrations require more development and security configuration.
explanations.B: Incorrect. Step Functions orchestrate workflows but do not provide native SaaS integration.
explanations.C: Correct. Amazon AppFlow is a fully managed service designed for secure data transfer between SaaS applications and AWS services with encryption in transit and at rest using KMS.
explanations.D: Incorrect. Building a custom connector increases development and maintenance overhead.
explanations.correct: Amazon AppFlow natively integrates with Salesforce and supports encryption in transit and at rest using AWS KMS CMKs.

questions.text: A company is developing a mobile gaming app that uses TCP and UDP traffic and runs in a single AWS Region behind an Auto Scaling group. The app will be used globally, and the company wants the lowest possible latency for all users. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Global Accelerator with an Application Load Balancer that listens on TCP and UDP ports.
options.B: Use AWS Global Accelerator with a Network Load Balancer that listens on TCP and UDP ports.
options.C: Use Amazon CloudFront with a Network Load Balancer as the origin.
options.D: Use Amazon CloudFront with an Application Load Balancer as the origin.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Application Load Balancers do not support UDP traffic.
explanations.B: Correct. AWS Global Accelerator combined with a Network Load Balancer provides optimal global routing and supports both TCP and UDP traffic.
explanations.C: Incorrect. CloudFront does not support UDP-based workloads.
explanations.D: Incorrect. CloudFront and ALB are not suitable for UDP-based gaming traffic.
explanations.correct: Global Accelerator with NLB provides the lowest latency for global TCP and UDP traffic.

questions.text: A company processes customer orders on an EC2 instance that writes to an Amazon Aurora database. During traffic spikes, orders are not processed fast enough. What should a solutions architect do to write orders reliably and quickly?

options.A: Increase the EC2 instance size during high traffic and write orders directly to SNS.
options.B: Write orders to an Amazon SQS queue and process them using EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group.
options.C: Write orders to SNS and have EC2 instances process messages directly.
options.D: Write orders to SQS only when CPU thresholds are exceeded and use scheduled scaling.

explanations.A: Incorrect. SNS is not designed for durable buffering of workloads.
explanations.B: Correct. Amazon SQS decouples order ingestion from processing and ensures reliable, scalable order handling during traffic spikes.
explanations.C: Incorrect. SNS is a pub/sub service and not suitable for reliable workload buffering.
explanations.D: Incorrect. Conditional queuing and scheduled scaling add unnecessary complexity and reduce reliability.
explanations.correct: Using SQS provides reliable buffering and enables horizontal scaling of order processing.

questions.text: An IoT company collects 2 MB of data per device nightly and stores it in Amazon S3. Each dataset requires up to 1 GB of memory and completes processing within 30 seconds. Results must be available quickly. Which solution is the MOST cost-effective?

options.A: Use AWS Glue with a Scala job.
options.B: Use Amazon EMR with Apache Spark.
options.C: Use AWS Lambda with a Python script.
options.D: Use AWS Glue with a PySpark job.

explanations.A: Incorrect. AWS Glue is better suited for large-scale ETL jobs and incurs higher cost and startup time.
explanations.B: Incorrect. Amazon EMR is overkill and costly for small, short-running workloads.
explanations.C: Correct. AWS Lambda supports up to 10 GB of memory, runs within the required duration, and is billed per execution, making it the most cost-effective option.
explanations.D: Incorrect. Glue PySpark jobs have higher overhead and cost compared to Lambda.
explanations.correct: AWS Lambda provides the lowest cost and fastest execution for small, short-lived data processing tasks.

The developers work remotely and in the corporate office. The company wants to use AWS services as a part of the solution. The EC2 instances are hosted in a VPC privatesubnet and access the internet through a NAT gateway that is deployed in a public subnet. questions.text: A company has applications that run on Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances connect to Amazon RDSdatabases by using an IAM role that has associated policies. The company wants to use AWS Systems Manager topatch the EC2 instances without disrupting the running applications. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a new IAM role. Attach the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy to the new IAM role. Attach thenew IAM role to the EC2 instances and the existing IAM role.
options.B: Create an IAM user. Attach the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy to the IAM user. Configure SystemsManager to use the IAM user to manage the EC2 instances.
options.C: Enable Default Host Configuration Management in Systems Manager to manage the EC2 instances.
options.D: Remove the existing policies from the existing IAM role. Add the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy tothe existing IAM role.

explanations.correct:
IAM is AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) controls access to AWS resources.

To address the requirements, utilizing IAM is optimal. It is best for managing granular access policies. This aligns with Security.

Correct Answer: Enable Default Host Configuration Management in Systems Manager to manage the EC2 instances.
explanations.A: Incorrect. 'Create a new IAM role. Attach the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy to the new IAM role. Attach thenew IAM role to the EC2 instances and the existing IAM role.' is not the best fit. IAM is for permissions, not network security.
explanations.B: Incorrect. 'Create an IAM user. Attach the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy to the IAM user. Configure SystemsManager to use the IAM user to manage the EC2 instances.' is not the best fit. IAM is for permissions, not network security.
explanations.D: Incorrect. 'Remove the existing policies from the existing IAM role. Add the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy tothe existing IAM role.' is not the best fit. IAM is for permissions, not network security.

questions.text: A company recently launched Linux-based application instances on Amazon EC2 in a private subnet and launched aLinux-based bastion host on an Amazon EC2 instance in a public subnet of a VPC. questions.text: A solutions architect is designing a two-tier web application. The application consists of a public-facing web tierhosted on Amazon EC2 in public subnets. The database tier consists of Microsoft SQL Server running on AmazonEC2 in a private subnet. Security is a high priority for the company. How should security groups be configured in this situation? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure the security group for the web tier to allow inbound traffic on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.
options.B: Configure the security group for the web tier to allow outbound traffic on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.

questions.text: To meet security requirements, a company needs to encrypt all of its application data in transit whilecommunicating with an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance. A recent security audit revealed that encryption at rest isenabled using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS), but data in transit is not enabled. What should a solutions architect do to satisfy the security requirements?

options.A: Enable IAM database authentication on the database.
options.B: Provide self-signed certificates. Use the certificates in all connections to the RDS instance.
options.C: Take a snapshot of the RDS instance. Restore the snapshot to a new instance with encryption enabled.
options.D: Download AWS-provided root certificates. Provide the certificates in all connections to the RDS instance.

explanations.correct:
KMS is AWS KMS manages cryptographic keys.

To address the requirements, utilizing KMS is optimal. It is best for encrypting data at rest. This aligns with Security.
